races.race_name: Wakefield Thornes Cricket Club Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Poppy Foxy
runners.spotlight: Won a Chester seller last month (7f, good to soft) and ran to a similar level of form when fifth in a Salisbury novice last week (6f, good to firm); a chance on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Chester seller winner who was a decent 5th in novice last week; interesting on h'cap debut

runners.name: Givendale
runners.spotlight: Shaped with plenty of promise when fifth in a Beverley maiden on her debut (5f, good to soft; not the best of runs, flashed tail); disappointing since; a bit to prove on her handicap debut.
runners.comment: Promising fifth in a Beverley maiden on debut (good to soft) but disappointing since.

runners.name: Spirit Of Mary
runners.spotlight: Signs of promise, including when fourth in a Beverley claimer last time (5f, good to firm); an interesting contender off this basement mark on her handicap debut.
runners.comment: Signs of promise, including fourth in a Beverley claimer; interesting off basement mark

runners.name: Priscilla's Hope
runners.spotlight: Best run when 4.25l fifth of nine in a Redcar maiden on third start (6f, good to firm); chance on that form, but was disappointing in a Nottingham novice last time (5f, good to soft); today's better ground should suit; handicap debut.
runners.comment: Best run when 5th in a maiden two runs ago; poor run latest (good to soft); a possible

runners.name: Black Cuillin
runners.spotlight: Fourth in maidens over 5f/6f on good ground here and merits consideration off her low mark on her handicap debut.
runners.comment: Fourth in maidens over 5f/6f here and is worth considering on her handicap debut

runners.name: Fasthope
runners.spotlight: Has shown signs of promise, notably when 7l third over C&D on debut (good to soft); not quite so good since; looks to have stiffish task on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Signs of promise including 3rd in a C&D maiden on debut; not obviously well treated

runners.name: Claret And Blues
runners.spotlight: Creditable fifth in a 5f novice here on debut (good); fair run on AW next time, but not so good in a Chester seller when last seen out in May (6f, good); not obviously well treated on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Fifth in a 5f novice here on debut; needs to bounce back from a lesser run last time.

runners.name: Baila Morena
runners.spotlight: Best run when 4.25l fourth in a maiden at Redcar on second start (6f, good); not so good on other two starts (well beaten in a York seller last time).
runners.comment: Best run when fourth in a Redcar maiden on second start; not as good on other two runs
runners.owner: T&t Racing Ltd And Keith West

races.race_name: Noel John Curtin Memorial Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Kinetic Impact
runners.spotlight: Has shown promise in both starts over this trip, finishing fourth of eight on his Chepstow debut (good to firm) in May and third of six at Sandown (good) last month; that's among the best form on offer in this contest; major chance.
runners.comment: Has shown promise in both starts over this trip at Chepstow and Sandown; major chance

runners.name: Tiernan
runners.spotlight: Third of seven in Listed event at Hamilton (1m3f, good; 150-1) a year ago, but turned over at 1-5 there the following month and has beaten just two rivals in three starts in warm handicaps since; this is easier, but still too many doubts for comfort.
runners.comment: Flattered by his third in Listed event at Hamilton a year ago; too many doubts for comfort

runners.name: Talitha Rouge
runners.spotlight: Made a promising start when third of six behind two susbsequent winners on her Redcar debut (1m2f, good to firm) in May, but took a step backwards when only fourth of five at Thirsk (1m4f, good) three weeks ago; still a player if bouncing back to her debut form.
runners.comment: Third on Redcar debut in May, but took a step backwards next time; player if bouncing back

runners.name: Steel Raven
runners.spotlight: Has finished third in both starts, firstly at Carlisle (1m1f, good to soft) last month and at Thirsk (1m, good to firm) six days ago; shapes as though this longer trip may suit even if he isn't bred for it; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Third in both starts; shapes as though this longer trip may suit; shortlisted

runners.name: Twin And Tonic
runners.spotlight: 150-1 when a tailed-off last of 11 on her Wetherby debut (7f, good to firm) last month.
runners.comment: 150-1 when a tailed-off last of 11 on her Wetherby debut last month

runners.name: Freddy Fearless
runners.spotlight: Never threatened when fourth of seven on last month's Leicester debut (1m, good; 100-1); may be one for handicaps in due course.
runners.comment: Never threatened on last month's Leicester debut; may be one for handicaps in due course

runners.name: Khepri
runners.spotlight: Set the pace before dropping away to finish last of four on her Doncaster debut (1m2f, good to firm; 9-1) 17 days ago; improvement required.
runners.comment: Last of four on her Doncaster debut 17 days ago; improvement required

runners.name: Moon Zabeel
runners.spotlight: Sent off 11-1 when a well-held sixth of seven on last month's Lingfield debut (11.6f, good); has a taking pedigree and likely to do better in due course, but he will need plenty of improvement on that initial effort.
runners.comment: Taking pedigree but well held on his Lingfield debut; will need plenty of improvement

runners.name: Hellion
runners.spotlight: Third in two novices (1m2f, good to soft) for Brian Meehan as a 2yo, but has shown nothing in four starts over hurdles for this yard; return to the Flat may help, but risky all the same.
runners.comment: Third in both novices as a 2yo but nothing in four starts over hurdles for new yard; risky

runners.name: Sixty Plus
runners.spotlight: Won four times over hurdles between July and September last year, but lost his way in that sphere and showed nothing in two starts on the Flat (11.4f, 1m6f) last month; look elsewhere.
runners.comment: Four wins over hurdles in the middle of last year, but modest under both codes since

races.race_name: Weatherbys Pipalong Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)

runners.name: Arisaig
runners.spotlight: Losing run up to 15 but she has run some fine races in that period, not least when beaten less than a length into third of six in the Group 2 Celebration Mile at Goodwood (1m, good to firm) last August (entered again this year); respected on these terms and Jamie Spencer knows her well; still holds a Sussex Stakes entry.
runners.comment: Losing run now 15, but has run some fine races in that period; respected on these terms

runners.name: Cheshire Dancer
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in this race last year before going on to beat American Gal by a neck in a Group 3 at Ascot (1m, good) 18 days later; not at the same level in three starts this year and although not beaten that far in the Kensington Palace at Ascot (1m, good to firm) last month (four of these behind), still more will be needed.
runners.comment: Runner-up in this last year before winning a Group 3 at Ascot; not in same form this year

runners.name: Consecrated
runners.spotlight: Looked promising when making a winning debut at Newbury (7f, good) in April last year, but hasn't built on it in her six outings since; needs the application of cheekpieces to make a difference.
runners.comment: Looked good on her Newbury debut in April last year but hasn't built on it; cheekpieces on

runners.name: Radiant Beauty
runners.spotlight: 6-19, her latest success when making all to win a handicap at Ascot (1m, good) in May, but she finished behind three of these in the Kensington Palace back there (1m, good to firm) last month; more needed.
runners.comment: Finished behind three of these in the Kensington Palace last month; more needed

runners.name: Bellarchi
runners.spotlight: Could hardly be coming into this in better form, winning four of her last five starts including another Listed event at Chester (7f, good) ten days ago; still favoured on these terms despite her 3lb penalty and although the stiffer mile is one small question mark, she is a major player nonetheless.
runners.comment: Winner of four of her last five starts including another Listed race; major player

runners.name: Mobberley Rose
runners.spotlight: Made a belated winning debut at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) in March, but probably put up a better performance when second of six (well clear of the third) behind a subsequent winner under her penalty in a Bath novice (1m, firm) in May; has plenty more on her plate here, but she is an unexposed filly from a major stable.
runners.comment: Has plenty more on her plate here, but is an unexposed filly from a major stable

runners.name: Never Let Go
runners.spotlight: Twice runner-up in Listed company, the latest at Kempton (1m, AW) in March; has failed to beat a rival in two starts since, though the very soft ground may have counted against her at Longchamp (1m) last time; can be given a chance on these terms if rediscovering her best form.
runners.comment: Twice runner-up in Listed company; not so good last two starts, but a chance on best form

runners.name: American Gal
runners.spotlight: Won a Listed race at Chantilly (1m, good) to soft in May last year and beaten a neck by Cheshire Dancer in a Group 3 at Ascot (1m, good) two months later; out of the frame in her last five starts, though, and others make more appeal; stable also runs Never Let Go.
runners.comment: Won a French Listed race and went close in a Group 3 last year, but not in same form since

runners.name: Brazilian Rose
runners.spotlight: All eight wins have come on the AW and is 0-8 on turf, including when just under 3l behind Bellarchi at Chester (7f, good) ten days ago; 3lb pull not enough to tempt, especially as she has never attempted this far before.
runners.comment: Under 3l behind Bellarchi at Chester ten days ago; has never attempted this far before

runners.name: Goldilocks Cen
runners.spotlight: Won a Dieppe maiden (1m3f, heavy) a year ago, but not seen again until well held on her stable debut in the Kensington Palace at Ascot (1m, good to firm) last month (behind four of these); hard to recommend.
runners.comment: Finished behind four of these on stable debut at Ascot last month; hard to recommend

runners.name: Mostar Dreams
runners.spotlight: Won a Newcastle handicap (1m, AW) in January and was returning from an absence when beaten a nose at Carlisle (7f, good to firm) 13 days ago; she will need a lot more in order to figure in this company.
runners.comment: Beaten a nose on her latest start; will need a lot more in order to figure in this company
runners.owner: J Fyffe, A Edmondson & L McGurty

runners.name: Crystal Flyer
runners.spotlight: Placed just once in 13 starts since her latest success and finished behind a couple of these on her third start for the yard in the Kensington Palace at Ascot (1m, good to firm) last month; down the list.
runners.comment: Placed just once in 13 starts since her latest success; down the list
runners.owner: Castle Racing Co Ltd & Mps Racing Ltd

races.race_name: Pontefract Park Silver Sprint Trophy Handicap

runners.name: Dark Cloud Rising
runners.spotlight: Bounced back from some lesser efforts when making all and scoring comfortably from a subsequent winner at Ripon (6f, good) 19 days ago; the visor may have helped and although similar tactics may not be so easy in this field, he doesn't have to lead; much respected from 6lb higher.
runners.comment: Made all at Ripon last time and the second has won since; much respected from 6lb higher

runners.name: Garfield Shadow
runners.spotlight: Useful for Richard Fahey, winning five times the latest of which was a 7f handicap in Qatar in November 2024; makes his debut for his new yard (gelded in the meantime) and, like his stablemate The Strikin Viking, whether he is on a favourable mark remains to be seen; the choice of James Doyle, though, so interesting to see what the market says.
runners.comment: Off 20 months and not sure how well treated he is, but is the choice of James Doyle

runners.name: Badri
runners.spotlight: Has performed well in both starts over C&D, including a game success 16 days ago (good); much more exposed than his rivals, but still high on list from 3lb higher.
runners.comment: Performed well in both starts over C&D, including a game success last time; high on list

runners.name: Beaujolais Nouveau
runners.spotlight: Responded well to first-time cheekpieces and a drop in the weights when winning at Ripon (6f, good) in May and beaten less than a length into fifth of 12 off this mark at York (6f, good) last month; shouldn't be far away.
runners.comment: Won at Ripon in May and finished a close fifth at York last month; shouldn't be far away

runners.name: El Bodon
runners.spotlight: Returned to his useful 2yo form when winning twice at Kempton (6f, AW) in the winter, but hasn't built on it and failed to beat a rival at Windsor (6f, good to firm) eight days ago; application of cheekpieces will need to bring about a resurgence.
runners.comment: Won twice on the Kempton AW in the winter, but hasn't built on it; cheekpieces on

runners.name: The Strikin Viking
runners.spotlight: Has been on his travels, winning a Group 3 at Baden-Baden (6f, soft) last August but finishing unplaced at Woodbine, Meydan and Doha in the meantime; returns from another five months off and hard to know how well handicapped he is; stable also runs Garfield Shadow.
runners.comment: Has been on his travels; off five months and hard to know how well handicapped he is

races.race_name: Pontefract Squash And Leisure Club Handicap

runners.name: Jedhi Knight
runners.spotlight: Was having his second start for the yard and first since wind surgery when fifth of 11 at Newcastle (1m4f, AW) five weeks ago; 2lb lower than when winning at Ffos Las (2m, good to soft; first-time cheekpieces) last August and worth a second look, especially if backed.
runners.comment: 2lb lower than when winning at Ffos Las last August; worth a second look

runners.name: Cloudy Rose
runners.spotlight: Ran with credit when fourth of nine at Yarmouth (1m6f, soft) last month and does handle testing ground, but looks better on a faster surface; 5lb lower than for the latest of two wins around this time last year and one for the shortlist.
runners.comment: 5lb lower than for the latest of two wins this time last year; one for the shortlist

runners.name: Regal Glory
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-40 when winning by a neck at Beverley (1m2f, good) three weeks ago; wouldn't normally be an obvious one to follow up, but she is only 2lb higher and the runner-up has won since; shortlisted.
runners.comment: 2lb higher than when beating a subsequent winner at Beverley last time; shortlisted

runners.name: Dubai Venture
runners.spotlight: Not at his best in a 0-70 at Carlisle (1m3f, good to soft) four weeks ago, but likely to do better especially if the ground continues to dry out, with his two wins last year (including one over C&D) coming on good to firm; big player down in grade.
runners.comment: C&D winner; will be very much suited by drying ground; big player down in grade

runners.name: Princess Vivi
runners.spotlight: 0-11, but has shown some ability and didn't seem to lack for stamina when a close fourth of six at Beverley (1m4f, good) a fortnight ago; could make the frame again.
runners.comment: 0-11, but didn't seem to lack for stamina when a close fourth at Beverley a fortnight ago

runners.name: Muhib
runners.spotlight: Often makes the frame and would have found 1m6f too far at Nottingham 12 days ago, but he is now 0-25; others preferred.
runners.comment: Often makes the frame, but is now 0-25; others preferred

runners.name: Yakhabar
runners.spotlight: Easily landed an amateur riders' event at Southwell (1m4f, AW) in March and wasn't beaten far into fourth of 12 in a similar contest at Ripon (1m4f, good) last time, but he still needs more in order to come out best here.
runners.comment: Last two wins have come in amateur riders' races; needs more to come out best here

runners.name: Apache Eagle
runners.spotlight: Has made the frame several times this year including when third of seven over C&D (good to soft) in May, but a record of 0-22 is hard to ignore.
runners.comment: Has made the frame several times this year, but a record of 0-22 is hard to ignore

runners.name: Coverbridge
runners.spotlight: 0-15 since winning a Newcastle maiden (7f, AW) as a 2yo, but was beaten less than a length into third of eight at Leicester (1m4f, good to firm) 12 days ago; could play a part if building on that.
runners.comment: Beaten less than a length into third at Leicester 12 days ago; could play a part

runners.name: Clipsham Noble
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-28 when successful at Leicester (1m4f, good to firm) in May and although a fair fourth of eight back there 12 days ago (Coverbridge third), it does suggest he needs a bit more off this mark.
runners.comment: Won at Leicester in May and fourth there last month, but needs a bit more off this mark

runners.name: Lednikov
runners.spotlight: Often a front runner who has gained six of his seven wins on the AW at Southwell; Elle-May Croot knows him especially well, but a record of 1-20 on turf suggests others are more likely.
runners.comment: Often a front runner; record of 1-20 on turf suggests other are more likely

races.race_name: Go Racing Bet With Jayne Handicap

runners.name: Harswell Ruby
runners.spotlight: Blew the start at Carlisle 13 days ago, so possible to forgive that, and is just 1lb higher than when winning at Thirsk (1m, good) in April; this stiff mile should suit her well and one of the more interesting ones.
runners.comment: 1lb above her last winning mark; this stiff mile should suit her well; interesting

runners.name: Welbury
runners.spotlight: Has run to a similar level in three turf handicaps since winning a Southwell novice (1m, AW) in March; still unexposed and again holds each-way claims at least.
runners.comment: Has run to a similar level in turf handicaps since winning a Southwell novice; unexposed

runners.name: Rajapour
runners.spotlight: Has made the frame a few times this year including off higher marks, but is just 1-24 since joining this yard; others more compelling.
runners.comment: Has made the frame a few times this year, is just 1-24 since joining this yard

runners.name: Sailthisshipalone
runners.spotlight: Back off the same mark as when making a successful stable debut/reappearance over C&D (good to soft; first-time tongue-tie) in April; possible to forgive his latest effort on the AW and holds good claims otherwise, albeit good to firm ground may pose a small question.
runners.comment: Back off the same mark as when winning over C&D in April; fast ground may pose a question

runners.name: Clonquest
runners.spotlight: Nicely bred and has shown ability in his last two starts, albeit the trip appeared to stretch him when third of seven at Thirsk (1m, good) last time; makes his handicap debut in a first-time hood after three months off having been gelded in the meantime; market support would be interesting.
runners.comment: Makes his handicap debut in a first-time hood after three months off; watch market

runners.name: Star Banner
runners.spotlight: Placed in two of his three starts, the latest when third of nine in a Windsor novice (1m, good to firm) 15 days ago; open to further improvement now handicapping and respected.
runners.comment: Placed in two of his three starts; open to further improvement now handicapping

runners.name: Mount King
runners.spotlight: Three of his four wins have come over C&D and is 5lb lower than for the latest a year ago; well beaten in his last two visits, though, so has something to prove.
runners.comment: Three of his four wins have come over C&D, but well beaten in his last two visits

runners.name: Wetsand
runners.spotlight: Looked a nice prospect this time last year with wins at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) and Goodwood (1m, good to firm), but she has become disappointing; down another 2lb and needs the cheekpieces to help halt the slide.
runners.comment: Has become disappointing; needs the cheekpieces to help halt the slide

runners.name: Flying Fletcher
runners.spotlight: Had dropped to his last winning mark when third of seven at Wetherby (1m, good to firm) last time, but he is now 0-14 on turf; another placing may be his best hope.
runners.comment: Still off his last winning mark, but is 0-14 on turf; another placing may be his best hope

runners.name: War Howl
runners.spotlight: Won twice over 7f this time last year for Mick Appleby and is 8lb lower than when successful at Ascot on the second occasion, but six starts for this yard so far this year leave plenty to be desired; others safer.
runners.comment: 8lb below last winning mark, but six starts for this yard leave plenty to be desired
runners.owner: Future Champions Racing Syn & Ben Haslam

races.race_name: Tallbaldybloke Three Score And Ten Birthday Handicap

runners.name: Betweenthesticks
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner and again ran well when dead-heating for second with Dream Deal behind Hover On The Wind here eight days ago; likely to be bang there again.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner and dead-heated for second with Dream Deal here eight days ago; bang there
runners.owner: J A Swinburne & Mrs Ruth A Carr

runners.name: Cheerleader
runners.spotlight: Won her first two starts for the yard in May last year, but her form since then has been uneven; well held on last month's Thirsk return (5f, good; first start since a second wind operation) and she needs to improve on that.
runners.comment: Well held on last month's Thirsk return and she needs to improve on that

runners.name: Sea Her Excel
runners.spotlight: Broke her duck at the sixth attempt when making all at Wetherby (5.5f, good to firm) last month, but a 6lb rise appeared to find her out at Windsor (5f, good to firm) 11 days later; more will be needed to defy this mark; stable also runs Brave Empire.
runners.comment: Made all at Wetherby last month but held off this mark at Windsor next time; more needed

runners.name: Storm Call
runners.spotlight: Reponded well to the fitting of blinkers when winning at Redcar (5f, good) last October, but not matched that form since; also has something to prove over this stiffer 5f.
runners.comment: Won in first-time blinkers at Redcar last October, but not matched that form since

runners.name: Dandy Dinmont
runners.spotlight: Back off the same mark as when winning narrowly at Beverley (5f, good) in May, but he hasn't proved very consistent so far this year so not quite sure what to expect.
runners.comment: Off same mark as when winning at Beverley in May, but not very consistent so far this year

runners.name: Brave Empire
runners.spotlight: Losing run up to 21, but he ran well to finish a close fourth of 16 at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) last month; a few winners have come out of that race and a hood is given a go, but the drop to 5f may not be ideal even on a stiff track like this.
runners.comment: Fourth of 16 over 6f at Doncaster last month, but the drop to 5f may not be ideal; hood on

runners.name: Hover On The Wind
runners.spotlight: Made the most of dropping 2lb below his previous winning mark when beating the dead-heaters Betweenthesticks and Dream Deal by a length over C&D (good) eight days ago; 5lb penalty shouldn't preclude another big effort given he has twice won from 1lb higher.
runners.comment: 5lb penalty for C&D win eight days ago, but has twice won from 1lb higher

runners.name: Dream Deal
runners.spotlight: 1lb below his previous winning mark when successful at Beverley (5f, good) last month before dead-heating for second with Betweenthesticks behind Hover On The Wind over C&D eight days ago; enjoyed anything but a clear run then and he may emerge best of the trio this time granted more luck.
runners.comment: Dead-heated for second with Betweenthesticks here eight days ago; player again

runners.name: Showtime Mahomes
runners.spotlight: Seems versatile as regards underfoot conditions and is back off the same mark as when winning at Southwell (6f, AW) in January; off 133 days, but can go well fresh.
runners.comment: Versatile ground-wise and back off last winning mark; off 133 days, but can go well fresh

races.race_name: CopyBet Proudly Backs UK Horse Racing Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: Eternal Angel
runners.spotlight: Promising in defeat for Nicky Henderson before a stint in Ireland; has made a positive start for Tom Lacey, winning at Huntingdon (2m, good to firm) and running just as well in defeat when penalised here last month (good); has raced freely and now goes in a hood.
runners.comment: Sets the standard on his two runs for Tom Lacey; has raced freely and now goes in a hood

runners.name: Ride Like A Girl
runners.spotlight: First run after wind surgery and in a new tongue-tie when cosily justifying favouritism in a 2m handicap at Huntingdon (good to firm; second a winner since); has good form claims for last year's winning yard.
runners.comment: Handicap winner last time out and has good form claims for last year's winning yard
runners.owner: Awr Ltd Sperling Snowden Morley & Stacey

runners.name: Mystic Wind
runners.spotlight: Beaten 28l and 37l in two good-ground maidens at Worcester (hooded for both); in a top yard but the positives stop there and probably one for handicaps.
runners.comment: Beaten 28l and 37l in two good-ground maidens at Worcester (hooded for both)

runners.name: Aimeric
runners.spotlight: He was very smart on the Flat when in his prime but left Karl Burke under a cloud and has yet to get anything going for current yard, on the Flat and in two runs over hurdles; looks on a slippery slope.
runners.comment: He was very smart on the Flat when in his prime but looks on a very slippery slope now

runners.name: Dancingondiamonds
runners.spotlight: Fifth in two Flat maidens in Ireland (1m/1m4f); always behind and tailed off on stable/hurdle debut at Worcester (10-1); hood added; has a good bit to prove now.
runners.comment: Fifth in two Flat maidens in Ireland; 10-1 and was always behind at Worcester
runners.owner: The Soldiers Of Fortune Iv & Partner

runners.name: Arcon
runners.spotlight: Flat winner in France and added a 1m6f handicap at Haydock last August; no impact in two runs over hurdles, though reportedly finished lame after the latest.
runners.comment: Dual Flat winner; no impact in two runs over hurdles; finished lame after the latest

runners.name: Rose Warrior
runners.spotlight: Mostly well held in all his Flat races, especially in the two for current yard (1m6f, cheekpieces; 1m4f, visored); limited appeal on hurdling debut.
runners.comment: Mostly well held in all his Flat races, especially in the two for current yard

runners.name: Pearl Knot
runners.spotlight: Well related but went off 20-1 at Bangor and unseated at the very first flight.
runners.comment: Well related but went off 20-1 at Bangor and unseated at the very first flight

runners.name: Happy Harrison
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in two bumpers and suffered the same fate on hurdling debut at Bangor.
runners.comment: Tailed off in two bumpers and suffered the same fate on hurdling debut at Bangor

runners.name: Amalfina
runners.spotlight: Left Karl Burke for 7,000gns and as a seven-race maiden; 150-1 when never a factor on hurdle debut at Worcester.
runners.comment: Left Karl Burke for 7,000gns and as a seven-race maiden; tailed off on hurdle debut

races.race_name: CopyBet Daily World Cup Profit Boost Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.name: That's Nice
runners.spotlight: Generally disappointing since her two wins over hurdles in the 2024/25 season and she's now 0-6 as a chaser, from 2m3f to 3m; needs a lift from this new headgear combination.
runners.comment: Generally disappointing since her two wins over hurdles and she's now 0-6 as a chaser

runners.name: Ice Jet
runners.spotlight: 5lb well in under a double penalty when completing a ten-day hat-trick over hurdles at Worcester (2m4f, good); 7lb higher this time but this 4yo is improving and seems game, so could well continue the good work as a chaser.
runners.comment: 5lb well in under big penalty when completing ten-day hat-trick over hurdles; chase debut

runners.name: Jiair Madrik
runners.spotlight: Won easily over 2m5f here (good) and then made all at Worcester (2m4f, good) where it was harder work; now has to deal with a 6lb rise but he's on a roll.
runners.comment: Won his last two; has to deal with a 6lb rise for last time but he's on a roll

runners.name: The Clonmel Kid
runners.spotlight: Hasn't really kicked on since making the breakthrough over fences at Newcastle (2m4f, good) in April and Hexham last time was a backward step; previous efforts weren't too bad, so if forgiven that last run a case could be made off this mark.
runners.comment: Hasn't really kicked on since making the breakthrough over fences at Newcastle in April

runners.name: Gaelic Rambler
runners.spotlight: Didn't hang about over hurdles; best chase efforts (0-5) have been over shorter but should stay this far and he's better than he showed last time at Ffos Las; can run well if back on song.
runners.comment: He's better than he showed last time at Ffos Las; can run well if back on song

runners.name: Back In The Bay
runners.spotlight: Second hurdle win for this yard when taking a mares' handicap at Stratford (2m3f, good) last July but very disappointing in her last two runs after lengthy breaks; makes chase debut and she was second in a point.
runners.comment: Hurdle winner but poor the last twice; makes chase debut and she was second in a point
runners.owner: Value Racing - Back In The Bay

runners.name: Hudson
runners.spotlight: Competitive in handicap hurdles but he's not bred for fences and unseated early on his first attempt at Bangor (2m1f, good; 8-1); likely best watched on the back of that.
runners.comment: Competitive in handicap hurdles but he's not bred for fences and unseated early at Bangor
runners.owner: Miss Jayne Brace & Mrs Karen Smith

runners.name: Seeitoldya
runners.spotlight: Point winner who ran well enough in defeat at times over hurdles for former yard; unseated over hurdles and well beaten over fences for this yard; had three months off.
runners.comment: Unseated over hurdles and well beaten over fences for this yard; had three months off

races.race_name: Peter Smith Birthday Celebration Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Eaton Anne
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler but yet to score after four runs over fences; good second at Hexham two runs back (3m, good to soft; first run after wind op and in cheekpieces) but poor last time; could bounce back with visor now tried.
runners.comment: 0-4 over fences but chance on Hexham second two runs back; poor latest; headgear switch

runners.name: Fairlawn Flyer
runners.spotlight: Has won ten of his 30 chases, four of them last year; hasn't been in quite such good form this term, last time finishing 8l fourth of six at Cartmel (3m1f, good), but he's on a good mark now.
runners.comment: 10-30 over fences (four wins last year); not at his best this summer but on a good mark

runners.name: A Dublin Job
runners.spotlight: Three chase wins for Harry Derham (2m3f/2m4f); yet to hit form for new yard following 309 days off.
runners.comment: Three chase wins for Harry Derham; yet to hit form for new yard after 309 days off

runners.name: Paper Mill
runners.spotlight: Prolific winning pointer; off the mark on second start for Stuart Edmunds when winning over C&D in November (soft; off 6lb lower), but pulled up here next time (jockey reported that he never travelled); goes well on good ground; interesting.
runners.comment: Prolific pointer; C&D win for new yard in November; could go well after a break

runners.name: Ivane
runners.spotlight: Has won two of his 12 races over fences, most recently over 3m5f at Sedgefield last October (good), but not in top form on last three starts.
runners.comment: 2-12 over fences, latest over 3m5f at Sedgefield in October; below best on last three runs

runners.name: Karnaval Point
runners.spotlight: Has done most of his racing in France but two good runs for David Pipe, winning at Worcester on stable debut (2m4f, good) before a good third off 9lb higher here since (2m5f); up another 2lb and in trip (won over 2m7f in France); interesting.
runners.comment: Most racing in France; two sound races for David Pipe; interesting despite 11lb rise

races.race_name: CopyBet Support Safer Gambling Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Sunray Shadow
runners.spotlight: Bids for a four-timer after two wins over hurdles and a chase success in between; had nothing in hand last time at Worcester (2m7f, good) and he'll need another career best off 4lb higher.
runners.comment: Had nothing in hand last time at Worcester and he'll need another career best here
runners.owner: S T Racing - The Founders' Syndicate

runners.name: Abbey Scope
runners.spotlight: Looking very progressive and impressed in how he came through to beat a subsequent winner at Hexham one month ago on his first try over this far (good ground); could well take the 7lb rise in his stride.
runners.comment: Impressed with how he came through to beat a subsequent winner at Hexham a month ago

runners.name: Smugglers Haven
runners.spotlight: Fell in her final chase run after a career-best win in a 3m1f handicap at Cheltenham; she's good over hurdles as well, making it 4-8 in this discipline when beating one other finisher by 30l at Fontwell last time out (2m5f, good); the handicapper didn't go overboard with a 5lb rise.
runners.comment: Useful chaser/hurdler; beat one rival by 30l in this discipline last time; 5lb higher

runners.name: Roger Pol
runners.spotlight: Won three 2m7f handicaps (all on good) in early part of last season, two over C&D; has failed to fire in two runs after a break but could be dangerous if all the better for a wind operation and new tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Goes well here; could be dangerous if all the better for a wind op and new tongue-tie

runners.name: Lipa K
runners.spotlight: Goes well at Bangor but probably best form yet when winning at Warwick in April (3m1f, good); ran no race at Cartmel (first-time tongue-tie, retained) but the return of cheekpieces is a positive.
runners.comment: Career-best form two runs back and the return of cheekpieces looks significant

runners.name: Champagne Twist
runners.spotlight: 2024 EBF Final winner off 4lb higher so on a good mark and he rediscovered some form when runner-up at Warwick (2m5f, good) in May; considered.
runners.comment: Well handicapped and he rediscovered some form when runner-up at Warwick in May

runners.name: Stumps Or Slips
runners.spotlight: Won two hunter chases in April on good ground before gifted a point walkover; can't be ruled out after those exploits and his hurdle figure is 10lb beneath his chase mark; had win and placed form for Olly Murphy in this discipline.
runners.comment: Won two hunter chases in April; his hurdle figure is 10lb beneath his chase mark

runners.name: Maghlaak
runners.spotlight: Made a winning start for this yard in a novice handicap chase last November but pulled up in his final chase and has finished last in two subsequent Flat starts; capable hurdler but hardly returns to this discipline at the top of his game.
runners.comment: Capable hurdler but hardly returns to this discipline at the top of his game

runners.name: Ernest Gray
runners.spotlight: Won two handicaps over similar trips to this last season, both on good ground; latest run in a Class 2 wasn't too bad and he's capable when fresh; this mark isn't beyond him.
runners.comment: Latest run in a Class 2 wasn't too bad and he's capable when fresh

runners.name: Dr Seb
runners.spotlight: Won a novice and a handicap over C&D (both on good) two years ago but struggled in a couple of handicap hurdles after a long absence and has since left Olly Murphy.
runners.comment: Struggled in two handicap hurdles after a long absence and has since left Olly Murphy

runners.name: Hillview
runners.spotlight: Four-time hurdle winner but beaten about 14l in two handicaps after three months off, and he was pulled up in his race prior to those; very opposable; first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Four-time hurdle winner but beaten about 14l in two handicaps after three months off

runners.name: Jet Of Magic
runners.spotlight: Useful hurdler back in the day but those times have probably gone for good; no form in two runs for this yard.
runners.comment: Useful hurdler back in the day but those times have probably gone for good

races.race_name: CopyBet Pay First Past The Post Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Rocks Up Late
runners.spotlight: All three defeats over hurdles have been in maidens; has since gone 5-9 over fences, last time making all at Stratford (2m1f, good to firm) after wind surgery; off the same mark for his handicap debut as a hurdler.
runners.comment: Made it 5-9 over fences last time; off the same mark for his handicap debut as a hurdler

runners.name: Cawthorne Banker
runners.spotlight: Proven winner who had lost his way but got back on track with a near miss at Worcester (2m, good) 20 days ago; just 2lb higher but the new blinkers (replacing cheekpieces) cast some doubts.
runners.comment: Back to form with a near miss at Worcester but new blinkers cast some doubts

runners.name: Buxted Reel
runners.spotlight: Three wins on the Flat; 0-8 as a jumper but was clear of the rest when a 7l runner-up at Stratford (2m, good) recently and something similar will see him on the scene.
runners.comment: 0-8 as a jumper but was clear of the rest when a 7l runner-up at Stratford

runners.name: Huit Reflets
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner whose latest success was over fences on Boxing Day; ran well in that scene afterwards but, following a break of 110 days, he finished well behind over hurdles at Hexham.
runners.comment: Capable hurdler/chaser but well held returning to this discipline at Hexham

runners.name: Genbu
runners.spotlight: Made all for a narrow success here in May and only 3lb higher now; has remained in fairly good form since; each-way claims.
runners.comment: Has remained in fairly good form since making all here three runs ago

runners.name: Tara Iti
runners.spotlight: Eight-time winner over hurdles who enjoys good ground but he's been quiet for a while now.
runners.comment: Eight-time winner over hurdles who enjoys good ground but he's been quiet for a while now

runners.name: Iolaos Du Mou
runners.spotlight: Made all for a narrow verdict at Warwick in May of last year; neither run since has been quite so good and current wellbeing is an issue.
runners.comment: Just two runs since last May's Warwick win and current wellbeing is an issue

runners.name: Network Rgb
runners.spotlight: No fireworks in his first three races and on RPRs this initial mark isn't obviously lenient; however, he is clearly open to improvement on handicap debut representing the Murphy/Bowen team.
runners.comment: Open to improvement on handicap debut representing the Murphy/Bowen team

runners.name: Colinski
runners.spotlight: Low-grade Flat winner; hurdle form nothing to shout about as when finishing third in a Hexham novice he was beaten 14l; others preferred on this handicap debut.
runners.comment: Low-grade Flat winner; hurdle form nothing to shout about; handicap debut

runners.name: Jammy Jay
runners.spotlight: Respectable efforts since switching to handicaps, notably a fourth at Aintree on Boxing Day (2m4f, good to soft; fine at 2m and on good); had a break since her no-show at Ludlow the following month; not dismissed.
runners.comment: Respectable form in handicaps and had a break since her no-show at Ludlow in January

runners.name: Whatcombe
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden under both codes and only recently changed hands for 1,200gns after pulling up on his handicap debut over hurdles.
runners.comment: Recently changed hands for 1,200gns after pulling up on his handicap debut over hurdles

races.race_name: Read Johnny Burke's Blog At CopyBet Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Prairie Queen
runners.spotlight: 0-16 over hurdles but came good over fences at the third attempt, making most at Hereford (2m, good); jumped to her left that day but to her right when beaten 4l at Worcester since; still ran well and she's in the mix.
runners.comment: 0-16 over hurdles but it's been a very solid start over fences; third off this mark latest

runners.name: Alshadhian
runners.spotlight: Was going okay when whacking the third last at Southwell (2m, good; beaten 15l) in June, a race he won the previous year off 11lb lower; he does look a shade high in the weights but can run well.
runners.comment: Latest third at Southwell could be upgraded but does look a shade high in the weights
runners.owner: G C Myddelton & V E C Taylor

runners.name: Walk The Plank
runners.spotlight: Won his third chase start at Huntingdon (2m, good) in March, edging home by a short head; hasn't reached those heights since, last time finishing behind two of these at Southwell.
runners.comment: Has won over fences but below par of late; behind two of these at Southwell latest

runners.name: Most Wanted
runners.spotlight: Low-grade Flat winner; 0-6 over hurdles but made a successful chase debut at Fakenham when too good for Getaway Jewel and one other finisher; this is deeper and he's up 5lb.
runners.comment: Successful chase debut at Fakenham when too good for Getaway Jewel and one other finisher

runners.name: Getaway Jewel
runners.spotlight: Five wins include four over fences; ran well but no match for Most Wanted at Fakenham in May on his return from a break; chance on that form even from 2lb out of the weights, and 2m3f looked too far last time.
runners.comment: Second to Most Wanted at Fakenham after a break and 2m3f looked too far last time

runners.name: Person Of Interest
runners.spotlight: Won over fences in Ireland last August (2m3f); his respectable stable debut was over hurdles (2m) and he was keeping on at the finish; wants further ideally but one to consider under Harry Cobden.
runners.comment: Won over fences in Ireland last August (2m3f); respectable stable debut was over hurdles

runners.name: Royal Rhythm
runners.spotlight: Had lots of racing over hurdles and without a win since late 2023; comfortably beaten in two runs after a break and has steered clear of fences since trying them once before over two years ago (tailed off).
runners.comment: Steered clear of fences since trying them once before over two years ago (tailed off)

runners.name: Electric Eddy
runners.spotlight: 1-11 over hurdles and 0-4 as a chaser; runner-up in his first chase last November but hasn't kicked on and was well behind Alshadhian at Southwell last time.
runners.comment: 2nd on chase debut but not kicked on; well behind Alshadhian last time at Southwell

runners.name: Fond Farewell
runners.spotlight: Low-grade Flat winner in Ireland back in 2023 (sole career success); unplaced in six races over hurdles and beaten 16.5l on chase debut at Southwell (behind Alshadhian) when a mid-race mistake didn't help.
runners.comment: Beaten 16.5l on chase debut (behind Alshadhian) when a mid-race mistake didn't help

runners.name: Feet On The Ground
runners.spotlight: 0-12 over hurdles but often placed; chase debut at Worcester was encouraging (2m, good) but she was lacklustre on her return visit when the 2m4f trip was no excuse; not entirely sure what to expect.
runners.comment: Chase debut was encouraging but lacklustre next time when 2m4f trip was no excuse

races.race_name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB)

runners.name: Iwanttobreakfree
runners.spotlight: Clear of the rest when chasing home the favourite in a 3m Irish point two months ago (good to yielding); now with Dan Skelton who adds a tongue-tie; he's of clear interest.
runners.comment: Clear of the rest when chasing home the favourite in a 3m Irish point two months ago

runners.name: Cavo Tagoo
runners.spotlight: 55,000euros 3yo; sixth foal; half-brother to four winners including Raffles Quattro, Quadrille Succes (both French 2m2f/2m3f hurdle) and Raffles Tour (French 2m1f chase); dam 2m3f hurdle winner; likely contender for powerful yard.
runners.comment: 55,000euros 3yo; half-brother to four winners; likely contender for powerful yard

runners.name: Teleleo
runners.spotlight: 22-1 at Worcester (good) in May, where he led 3f out and came home just over 4l to the good; there are doubts over what the form is worth and he has a penalty but still commands much respect.
runners.comment: 22-1 at Worcester (good) where he led 3f out and came home just over 4l to the good

runners.name: Naiad
runners.spotlight: Beaten 4l in 3m Irish point in April 2025; afterwards she was unraced for Joseph O'Brien; worth a market check.
runners.comment: Beaten 4l in 3m Irish point in April 2025; afterwards  unraced for Joseph O'Brien

runners.name: Jaunty Trooper
runners.spotlight: Ninth foal from a prolific family; bred to have a future but perhaps not in bumpers (yard 0-12 in this scene in recent seasons).
runners.comment: Ninth foal from a prolific family; bred to have a future but perhaps not in bumpers

runners.name: Rob Farmer
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-brother to 2m4f hurdle winner Isle Of Aron; dam placed 1m6f and 2m Flat (RPR 53) and bumper/2m4f hurdle winner; stable 0-17 in bumpers the last five seasons, which rates a negative.
runners.comment: Half-brother to 2m4f hurdle winner Isle Of Aron; stable 0-17 in bumpers last five seasons

runners.name: Zerouali
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-brother to 3m hurdle winner Hazy Dream; dam 2m hurdle winner; yard 0-9 in bumpers in recent seasons.
runners.comment: Fourth foal; half-brother to 3m hurdle winner Hazy Dream; dam 2m hurdle winner

races.race_name: Follow Tote On X Claiming Race

runners.name: Persian Bliss
runners.spotlight: Three AW wins for Adrian Murray; beaten 8l when second in a Dundalk claimer on last Flat start in March; pulled up over hurdles at Down Royal on latest; cheekpieces added to tongue tie; a bit to prove on grass.
runners.comment: Three AW wins, pulled up over hurdles on latest, a bit to prove on the grass

runners.name: Wolfpack
runners.spotlight: 1m Thirsk novice winner for James Ferguson last season; poor form over hurdles so far for this stable and after a slightly better run at Dundalk, was well behind Taj Crown and Timandi in a Limerick claimer latest; chance at the weights (rated 70) but risks attached.
runners.comment: 1m novice winner in Britain, behind couple of these at Limerick last time, risks attached

runners.name: Royal Approval
runners.spotlight: Fine record of 3-5 on the AW for Andrew Balding; 0-3 on turf on the Flat for that yard and hasn't troubled the judge in three runs over hurdles since joining this stable; pulled up over timber at Listowel after break latest; questions to answer.
runners.comment: 3-5 on AW in Britain, 0-3 on turf, poor form over hurdles for this yard, pulled up latest

runners.name: Plontier
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle at Sligo for Willie Mullins in August 2024; failed to win on the Flat for that stable (no Flat win since 2022) but far from disgraced in hot handicaps at the Curragh and Galway on last two runs on the level last season; has joined a new yard and worth checking in the market after a 208-day break.
runners.comment: New yard, decent efforts in hot handicaps on last two Flat starts, check the market

runners.name: Battling Siki
runners.spotlight: Ran okay on second start in a Dundalk maiden in January (10.5f) and again on turf debut when a 4.5l fifth of 15 at Bellewstown (11.5f, soft); struggled on better ground back there latest so has to prove he acts on this sort of surface; cheekpieces on.
runners.comment: Promise in two of four starts, struggled on better ground latest, cheekpieces go on

runners.name: Timandi
runners.spotlight: 0-14 overall (0-7 on turf) but wasn't beaten far at all in a 1m4f (gd-yld) claimer at Limerick on latest when an unconsidered 25-1 shot; also went close enough in a 1m4f Dundalk claimer in December; poorly treated on the figures but that was the case last time so could outrun likely odds again.
runners.comment: Fine effort on latest when poorly treated, same story again here, could outrun odds
runners.owner: Mrs N K Griffin & T Brosnan

runners.name: Taj Crown
runners.spotlight: Ran well in a Limerick claimer at this trip last month; below best in maidens the last twice and with a rating of 67 she's poorly treated by these race conditions but she can't be discounted in this company.
runners.comment: Ran well in Limerick claimer last month, poor in maidens last twice, could rebound

runners.name: Stone Rulya
runners.spotlight: Showed little in four runs for Ger Lyons and similar story on the Flat and over hurdles for this stable; rating of 66 could flatter him; hard to make a case for.
runners.comment: Showed little in four starts for Ger Lyons, no show yet for this yard, hard to fancy

races.race_name: Waterford Castle And Resort Style Evening August 15th Maiden

runners.name: Dream On Baby
runners.spotlight: Smart hurdles form since last seen on the Flat; won Listed event at Kempton (2m5f, good) last November; third to Woodhoh in Grade 3 at Leopardstown, second in a 3m Grade 2 at Doncaster; out of her depth in Grade 1 at Cheltenham; runner-up in all three starts in Flat maidens last season, the first over C&D; likely Galway-bound, but hard to oppose here.
runners.comment: Useful 134-rated mare over hurdles, runner-up on all three Flat starts, hard to oppose

runners.name: Blue Nasturtium
runners.spotlight: First foal; English Channel filly out of a 5f Listed winner by Choisir; sire was top-class over 1m4f, more speed than stamina on the dam's side.
runners.comment: By English Channel out of a 5f Listed winner, more speed than stamina on the dam's side

runners.name: Kimy
runners.spotlight: Has won only one of her 25 races over hurdles, placed six times, currently rated 99; never a threat in a 1m7f maiden at Leopardstown; marginally better over this trip at Fairyhouse last week; could be of interest with a handicap mark after this.
runners.comment: Has won only one of her 25 races over hurdles, well beaten in two recent Flat outings

runners.name: Big Dispute
runners.spotlight: Struggled after winning a bumper on debut in 2023; placed in three maiden hurdles last year; made the frame twice over hurdles in May; fair sixth of 16 behind subsequent Royal Ascot handicap winner Enceladus at Cork on his first run on the Flat; in rear at Ballinrobe on second attempt.
runners.comment: Bumper winner, first of two maiden runs was satisfactory, will probably need a mark

runners.name: El Galvino
runners.spotlight: In rear in this event last year; showed ability at Dundalk later in the campaign, notably when second over this trip; failed to reproduce that form over the same course and trip in February.
runners.comment: Has shown a fair standard of form on AW since finishing in rear in this event last year

runners.name: Jetoile
runners.spotlight: Six-time winner over jumps in Britain, best known for his 2023 win in the Old Roan Handicap Chase at Aintree; ordinary form in points and hunter chases for this stable before finding a new lease of life when winning a handicap hurdle at Ballinrobe in May; asking a lot here on belated Flat debut at the age of 11.
runners.comment: Veteran, six-time jumps winner in Britain, found new lease of life with recent hurdles win

runners.name: Way Down South
runners.spotlight: Point/maiden hurdle/beginners' chase winner; placed in two handicap hurdles before a below-par run at Listowel in May; no Flat experience.
runners.comment: Point/maiden hurdle/beginners' chase winner, no  Flat experience, others preferred

runners.name: Double Indian
runners.spotlight: In rear in a Kilbeggan bumper in April; remote ninth in a 1m4f Roscommon maiden last week.
runners.comment: In rear in a Kilbeggan bumper in April, remote ninth in a 1m4f Roscommon maiden last week

runners.name: Half Cut
runners.spotlight: Never looked like getting into serious contention in a 1m4f maiden at Fairyhouse last month.
runners.comment: Never looked like getting into contention in a 1m4f maiden at Fairyhouse last month

runners.name: Walls Cross
runners.spotlight: Lost ground at the start and never a danger on debut at Thurles; huge price then.
runners.comment: Lost ground at the start and never a danger on debut at Thurles, huge price then

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap

runners.name: Marmeladova
runners.spotlight: Ballinrobe maiden winner in May (9.5f, gd-yld); stayed on well for a 2.25l third of 10 on handicap debut back there on latest (9.5f, yielding); good ground fine and this step up in trip looks the right move; big chance.
runners.comment: Stayed on well over 9.5f on h'cap debut on latest, steps up in trip now, big player

runners.name: Daboya
runners.spotlight: Gained second turf win on latest at Ballinrobe (1m5f, yielding) under 5lb claimer; raised 7lb for that 3l success so effectively 12lb higher here with Keane taking over but clearly in good fettle and should run well again dropped slightly in trip (has won over 1m4f on good).
runners.comment: 1m5f Ballinrobe win on latest, raised 7lb, Keane takes over, has won at this trip before

runners.name: Justenzia
runners.spotlight: Started the season well with pleasing efforts at Gowran (9.5f, soft) and Ballinrobe (1m5f, gd-yld) but last three runs well below that level; handicapper relenting and conditions fine but needs to rediscover best.
runners.comment: Started season well but last three runs well below par, needs to rediscover best

runners.name: Kashel Spring
runners.spotlight: Two wins on the Flat (both 9.5f) last season for Joseph O'Brien; heavy defeats all four starts over timber since joining this stable; remains 7lb above last success and stamina to prove for this trip.
runners.comment: Dual Flat winner at 9.5f, poor over hurdles for this stable, stamina to prove for this far

runners.name: Sea Coral
runners.spotlight: 1m4f (good) Bellewstown maiden winner last year has finished down the field in better races than this in two runs this term; drops in grade now and tongue tie replaces the hood worn last time.
runners.comment: 1m4f maiden winner, soundly beaten both runs this term, down in grade, tongue tie on

runners.name: La Dame Blanche
runners.spotlight: Three-time turf winner but hasn't got her head in front since scoring off 12lb higher at Ballinrobe (1m5f, soft) in July 2024; three runs this term poor but acts on good ground and was second in this last season off 12lb higher; could revive.
runners.comment: No win since 2024, below par recently, 2nd in this last year off 12lb higher, could revive

runners.name: Questionable
runners.spotlight: Won at Sandown (1m2f, gd-fm) when trained by Daniel and Claire Kubler in 2024; heavy defeats in first two runs over hurdles for this stable; never raced over this far on the level and likely best watched on return to the Flat after short break.
runners.comment: Heavy defeats over hurdles last twice, likely best watched on return to the Flat

races.race_name: Tote Tramore Derby Handicap

runners.name: Highway Sixty One
runners.spotlight: Promising fourth on his stable debut/seasonal return at Dundalk over 1m4f; met some trouble in running when sixth at Fairyhouse; fair chance of turning the tables on Chopsticks (fourth) and of upholding form with Magna Gee Gee (sixth).
runners.comment: Met some trouble in running at Fairyhouse, may reverse form with Chopsticks now

runners.name: Chopsticks
runners.spotlight: 1-27, placed nine times; hard to be confident given his overall profile, but closely matched with Highway Sixty One and Magna Gee Gee on Fairyhouse running.
runners.comment: 1-27, placed nine times, closely matched with Highway Sixty One and Magna Gee Gee

runners.name: Churchwarden
runners.spotlight: Flat maiden; won a Kilbeggan handicap hurdle in 2024 when with John McConnell; down the field in two runs for this stable; seemed to be well fancied for a similar race to this at Roscommon on the first occasion; blinkered now after a poor hurdle run.
runners.comment: Winner over hurdles in 2024, down the field in two runs for this stable, blinkered now

runners.name: Vervain
runners.spotlight: Winner over this trip on good ground at Cork last summer for Joe Murphy; lacks a recent run and has changed stable; tongue-tie on for the first time.
runners.comment: Winner over this trip on good for Joe Murphy, lacks a recent run and has changed stable

runners.name: Plus Or Minus
runners.spotlight: Has failed to show much in three handicap attempts; may improve from recent stable debut when seventh of 14 at Down Royal.
runners.comment: Has failed to show much in three handicap attempts, may improve from recent stable debut

runners.name: Itsalonglongroad
runners.spotlight: 114-race veteran, winner of 11 races; best known as a four-time course jumps winner; also C&D winner; most recent success came over fences here last October; well below best on his last three visits, years may be catching up, but premature to write off.
runners.comment: 114-race veteran, best known as a four-time course jumps winner, also C&D winner

runners.name: Magna Gee Gee
runners.spotlight: Sole Flat win came on AW at Wolverhampton in December 2024 over an extended 1m1f; one of his better turf efforts when sixth at Fairyhouse last month, not far behind Chopsticks and Highway Sixty One.
runners.comment: Best form on AW, not far behind Chopsticks and Highway Sixty One at Fairyhouse last month

runners.name: Shakita
runners.spotlight: No sign of winning potential on the Flat or over hurdles; never closer than eighth place.
runners.comment: No sign of winning potential on the Flat or over hurdles, never closer than eighth place

runners.name: Jazz Forever
runners.spotlight: Has won on AW; 0-13 on turf; fair third over 1m5f at Navan before poor run at Bellewstown last week; visored first time; reserve.
runners.comment: Reserve, has won on AW, third over 1m5f at Navan before poor run at Bellewstown last week

runners.name: Fantasy Fara
runners.spotlight: Weak form in maidens; towards the rear in two soft-ground handicaps; hard to fancy unless first-time cheekpieces make a big difference.
runners.comment: Weak form in maidens, towards the rear in two soft-ground handicaps, cheekpieces tried now

runners.name: Appian Way
runners.spotlight: Has won twice over hurdles; nothing of much note in his Flat form; getting on in years; modest hurdles form since down the field at Dundalk in February.
runners.comment: Has won twice over hurdles, nothing of much note in his Flat form, getting on in years

runners.name: Brewel Hill
runners.spotlight: Almost two years since the most recent of his three wins; lack of a recent outing is a drawback.
runners.comment: Almost two years since the most recent of his three wins, lack of a recent run a drawback

runners.name: Surviving Murmansk
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 44 starts came in a hurdle race here last August; Flat form is unconvincing; may have needed the run over hurdles here in May.
runners.comment: Sole win from 44 starts came in a hurdle race here last August, Flat form is unconvincing

races.race_name: Tramoreraces.ie Handicap

runners.name: Soaring Sun
runners.spotlight: Won at Dundalk in January (1m4f) off 2lb lower; 0-4 on turf on varying ground and yet to trouble the judge, but three of those runs were in maidens; should be sharper for Leopardstown handicap run latest and not discounted.
runners.comment: Consistent on AW, won at Dundalk in Jan', sharper for latest run, not discounted

runners.name: Glendower
runners.spotlight: Maiden has finished in the first three in five of his nine Flat starts; not beaten that far in a Naas handicap latest (1m3f, good) when a shade keen early; eased 1lb and now wears a hood and tongue tie; could go well if settling better.
runners.comment: Not beaten that far in Naas h'cap latest, new headgear combo, chance if settles better

runners.name: Eastern Blue Bird
runners.spotlight: Very modest form so far over hurdles and on the level; slow away (not for the first time) and beaten 27l at Gowran (1m6f, gd-yld) on seasonal return latest; visor tried now.
runners.comment: Modest form so far, can be slowly away, heavy defeat again on  latest, visor tried now

runners.name: Showyoutheropes
runners.spotlight: 1m2f (gd-fm) winner for Tom Clover at Newmarket off 2lb lower last August; not beaten far on the latest run for this yard in March at Dundalk (10.5f); cheekpieces left off and worth a market check on return to turf after 109 days off.
runners.comment: 1m2f winner in Britain, ok 10.5f run for this yard at Dundalk in March, check market

runners.name: Oust
runners.spotlight: 3yo; promising efforts all three starts in handicaps; staying on sixth at Naas latest (1m3f, good) but only beaten 2.75l and wasn't far behind Forlio; this trip could suit and he's a leading contender.
runners.comment: Promise in all three h'caps, only beaten 2.75l latest, this trip could suit, big player

runners.name: A Pretty Penny
runners.spotlight: 3yo made all at Ballinrobe in May (9.5f, gd-yld); beaten off revised mark twice since and is 6lb wrong here (though that is negated by rider's claim); unproven over this far and needs to find more off this mark.
runners.comment: Made all at Ballinrobe in May, beaten off revised mark twice since, 6lb wrong here

runners.name: Metamorphic
runners.spotlight: Standout effort a 3l third in a 9.5f (heavy) maiden at Gowran last October; weakened over 1m5f on seasonal return at Ballinrobe; has had issues in the starting stalls before; cheekpieces added to tongue tie; needs more.
runners.comment: Best run on heavy, weakened over 1m5f on latest, new headgear combo tried

runners.name: Guy's Girl
runners.spotlight: Maiden is 0-6 on turf but has shown enough to suggest she can win a race; only beaten 4l when third at Ballinrobe latest (1m5f, yielding); eased 1lb and place claims again at the very least.
runners.comment: Maiden, 0-6 on turf, only beaten 4l on latest, eased 1lb, place claims at very least

runners.name: Miss Crinshawn
runners.spotlight: Promise on first two runs of the season for John O'Donoghue on yielding and soft to heavy; another decent effort when a 4.25l fourth on debut for this yard at Ballinrobe (1m5f, yld); good ground is a query, should go well if acts on it.
runners.comment: Promise all three starts this season including on stable debut latest, good ground a query

runners.name: Forlio
runners.spotlight: Won off 9lb lower at Navan last year; had been struggling off revised mark but step in right direction when an unlucky fourth at Naas (1m3f, good) 13 days ago; Colin Keane returns (on board for both previous wins); enters calculations.
runners.comment: Back to form with unlucky fourth at Naas, Keane on for both previous wins, big player

runners.name: Devine Genius
runners.spotlight: Best run for Adrian Murray came in a 2yo maiden at Tipperary (7f, soft) in May 2024; tailed off on debut for this stable at the Curragh last month; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Tailed off on debut for this stable at the Curragh last month, others appeal more

races.race_name: August Festival Early Bird Packages On tramoreraces.ie Handicap

runners.name: The Banger Doyle
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner in 2020; best known as a three-time chase scorer, runner-up five times on the Flat (three times at Killarney, twice at this venue); probably ran close to his handicap mark when third in a 1m7f maiden at Leopardstown last month.
runners.comment: Best known as a three-time chase scorer, runner-up five times on the Flat, good recent run

runners.name: Carthusian
runners.spotlight: Some promise in maidens; first four handicap runs have revealed limitations; visored now and dropped in class after contesting a strong contest at the Curragh.
runners.comment: Some promise in maidens, first four handicap runs have revealed limitations, visored now

runners.name: Spanish John
runners.spotlight: Both Flat wins last season were gained on soft ground; tailed off at the Curragh in May; no impression over hurdles last time; not one of the stronger contenders.
runners.comment: Both Flat wins last season were gained on soft ground, not one of the stronger contenders

runners.name: Voice Of Reason
runners.spotlight: Much better record on AW (three wins from nine starts, placed four times); 1-12 on turf and needs to improve on recent efforts.
runners.comment: Much better record on AW (three wins from nine starts), needs to improve on recent form

runners.name: Mr Rango
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner at 1m2f on soft or heavy, latest over two years ago; fair form this season and proved he can stay when second at 33-1 over 2m1f at Limerick last month.
runners.comment: All three wins have been at 1m2f, proved he can stay when second at Limerick last month

runners.name: Inchiquin Maid
runners.spotlight: Gained the most recent of two 2m AW wins in February; turf credentials are relatively weak, placed only once from ten attempts; however, suited by a sound surface.
runners.comment: Gained the most recent of two 2m AW wins in February, turf credentials are relatively weak

runners.name: Liberated Light
runners.spotlight: Beat today's rival The Banger Doyle in a 1m6f maiden at Killarney in 2023; a long time since his last Flat outing; however, he comes here in good shape after an emphatic win in a 2m handicap hurdle at this venue in May.
runners.comment: A long time since his last Flat outing. comes here in good shape after course hurdles win

runners.name: Master Sydney
runners.spotlight: Won a mares' bumper at Roscommon last July (good); fair effort on Flat handicap debut at Down Royal (1m5f, yielding); 1m2f too sharp on seasonal return; Roscommon sixth was satisfactory; had a valid excuse (almost slipped up) when fancied at Gowran on latest.
runners.comment: Bumper winner, had a valid excuse (almost slipped up) when fancied at Gowran on latest

runners.name: Matt Connor
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose performer; has won three of his last five races, two over hurdles and on the Flat at Gowran before finishing in mid-division in a handicap hurdle at the Punchestown festival; best Flat form at around 1m2f.
runners.comment: Versatile type who has won three of his last five starts, best Flat form at around 1m2f

runners.name: Must Meet Cecil
runners.spotlight: Five-time winning hurdler, including in a claiming event at this venue; not at his best for some time; well beaten in three Flat maidens this term.
runners.comment: Five hurdle wins, not at his best for some time;, well beaten in three Flat maidens

runners.name: Nelson Muntz
runners.spotlight: Sole success achieved at odds-on in a maiden hurdle at Kilbeggan last autumn; placed twice from ten starts on the Flat; could feature if reacting well to blinkers.
runners.comment: Winning hurdler, placed twice on the Flat, could feature if reacting well to blinkers

races.race_name: August Festival August 13th - 16th Handicap

runners.name: Synchronize
runners.spotlight: Maiden gelding by Frankel; started his career with the Gosdens; has shown potential for a belated breakthrough in his two most recent races; recovered from interference at the start to finish fourth over this trip at Down Royal in May; leading contender based on his second to solid yardstick Jurality over 1m5f at Navan; same good 7lb claimer aboard now.
runners.comment: Leading contender based on his second to solid yardstick Jurality over 1m5f at Navan

runners.name: Bynx
runners.spotlight: Three-time hurdles winner (also chase winner); 0-22 on Flat; fair placed form last season, though beaten 11l when third in this race 12 months ago; needs to step up on this term's outings at Gowran and Limerick.
runners.comment: Three-time hurdles winner (also chase winner), 0-22 on Flat; fair placed form last season

runners.name: Captain Hanley
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in maiden hurdles at Clonmel in May and Punchestown last month; failed to match that form at Wexford last Friday; interesting that he makes a quick reappearance with Colin Keane booked; turf Flat form is modest but not without a chance if reproducing last winter's best AW form.
runners.comment: Twice second in maiden hurdles in recent months, turf Flat form is modest, fair AW fom

runners.name: He Who Dares
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten at big odds in handicap hurdles at this venue (11th of 12 finishers) and Sligo (last of 16) before showing dramatic improvement to win at Wexford last Friday; trainer suggested that the removal of a hood might have been a major factor; hard to find any positives in last season's form in Flat maidens; good Flat pedigree, unwise to discount.
runners.comment: Showed dramatic improvement to win over hurdles at Wexford last Friday, enters the picture

runners.name: All In Peder
runners.spotlight: Back-to-back winner in staying handicaps at Gowran and Listowel for Emmet Mullins in May/June 2023; has run infrequently in recent years; tailed off at Listowel in May.
runners.comment: Won twice in 2023, has run infrequently in recent years, tailed off at Listowel in May

runners.name: You Make Me Smile
runners.spotlight: Four wins last year, two on the Flat, two over hurdles; placed twice on the Flat this season, beaten 7l when favourite for a 1m6f handicap at Sligo in May; good run when second in a mares' handicap hurdle at Downpatrick last month, well clear of the remainder.
runners.comment: Useful Flat/hurdles form last year, bright showing over hurdles at Downpatrick last month
runners.owner: T & R Hennessy & A Fahy Partnership

runners.name: Lariat
runners.spotlight: Veteran with 2-39 Flat turf record; most recent success was in 2022; often placed, including over hurdles; 33-1 when putting in a satisfactory display at Sligo a month ago on his first Flat outing this year.
runners.comment: 33-1 when putting in a satisfactory display at Sligo on his first Flat outing this year

runners.name: Takarengo
runners.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner; last success was in 2021; hard to take any encouragement from his Flat/hurdles form this year.
runners.comment: Last win was in 2021, hard to take any encouragement from his Flat/hurdles form this year

runners.name: Cala Gracioneta
runners.spotlight: Well held in AW handicaps; improved in first-time hood on turf return in late May when chasing home hot favourite Ballyadam over this trip at Listowel (good); moderate run over 1m4f at Bellewstown last week; return to longer trip should help.
runners.comment: Moderate run over 1m4f at Bellewstown last week, return to longer trip should help.

runners.name: Inchiquin Star
runners.spotlight: Won three hurdle races and a 1m6f Flat handicap for her previous trainer; suited by good ground; made a bright start for this stable when fourth in a handicap hurdle at Listowel last month.
runners.comment: Won three hurdle races and a 1m6f Flat handicap for her previous trainer, respected

runners.name: Black Soul
runners.spotlight: Point winner; won a Down Royal maiden hurdle in 2025; varied campaign this year; ran well up to the point of a fall two out in a chase at this venue in April; maiden on the Flat, runner-up three times; in rear at Dundalk in March.
runners.comment: Winning hurdler, maiden on the Flat, runner-up three times, in rear at Dundalk in March

runners.name: Reflectionist
runners.spotlight: Won two handicap hurdles for Gavin Cromwell in May 2023, both on good-to-yielding ground; has struggled over hurdles in recent seasons; has changed stable and now has his first Flat run since 2022.
runners.comment: Won two handicap hurdles for Gavin Cromwell in 2023, weak hurdles form in recent seasons

races.race_name: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Tyrant Gg
runners.spotlight: Showed improvement on his second start when runner-up in a similar contest at Kempton (7f) in May with first-time tongue-tie applied (retained); should not be far away.
runners.comment: Showed improvement when runner-up in a similar contest at Kempton in May.

runners.name: Rogue Invincible
runners.spotlight: Beaten a nose on his return to action in a similar contest at Wetherby (7f, good to firm) last month; looks sure to progress and should take all the beating.
runners.comment: Beaten a nose on his return to action in a similar contest at Wetherby last month.

runners.name: Asuka
runners.spotlight: Interesting that connections have persevered with this 4yo having been absent since making a winning debut at Newmarket in August 2024; has been gelded in the interim and commands plenty of respect, especially if the market signals are favourable.
runners.comment: Has been absent since making a winning debut at Newmarket in August 2024.
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Tago Mago
runners.spotlight: Fair third for Jamie Osborne on debut at Southwell last September; subsequently sold for 7,000gns; beaten 23l on stable debut at Wetherby (7f, good to firm) last month.
runners.comment: Beaten 23l on stable debut at Wetherby last month.

runners.name: Oddjob
runners.spotlight: 40,000gns yearling; eighth foal; half-brother to winners Mutawaffer (6f 2yo; RPR 87), Ray Vonn (6f; 80), Harswell (5f-1m; 72) and Golden Bear (Qatari 6f 2yo); dam 5f AW winner (79), sister to 6f 2yo Group 3 winner Habaayib; handler also trained the sire Starman; must be of interest if he is ready to roll on debut.
runners.comment: Handler also trained the sire and he's related to plenty of winners; must be of interest.

runners.name: Garth Spirit
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; by Massaat; half-sister to winners Ffion (7f including AW; RPR 98) and Dolly Gray (5f/6f; 81); dam 5f AW 2yo winner (75), closely related to 7f winner Call Me Grumpy, out of 1m2f winner; rare Flat runner for NH yard and best watched on debut.
runners.comment: Rare Flat runner for NH yard and best watched on debut.

runners.name: Cosmic Bond
runners.spotlight: 50,000gns yearlings; ninth foal; by Zoustar; brother to US 6.5f/1m turf winner Lunar Impact (including Listed; RPR 107), half-brother to two winners including Lehoogg (1m AW; 81); dam Listed-placed 6f winner (90), half-sister to dam of outstanding 5f performer Battaash; makes debut and likely to need more time.
runners.comment: Makes debut and likely to need more time.

runners.name: Forever Endless
runners.spotlight: Has shown just modest form in a couple of similar contests on turf; makes AW debut and needs to show improvement.
runners.comment: Has shown just modest form in a couple of similar contests on turf.

runners.name: Rua Mor
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish; has shown fair form over hurdles; well beaten in a couple of similar contests over around 1m here; likely to fare better when going handicapping.
runners.comment: Well beaten in a couple of similar contests over around 1m here.

runners.name: Hope And Joy
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way in 5f-6f maidens last August/September; steps up in trip and swaps hood for first-time cheekpieces; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in 5f-6f maidens last August/September.

races.race_name: Book Hotel & Conferencing At Wolverhampton Classified Stakes

runners.name: Havin A Flyer
runners.spotlight: No problem with conditions but she is a fully exposed maiden and likely to prove vulnerable once again.
runners.comment: Conditions no issue but fully exposed and likely to prove vulnerable again

runners.name: Bishop's Glory
runners.spotlight: Well short of his best on turf on his last two starts but perhaps better judged on this winter's AW efforts, which included a 6f win at Newcastle as well as several placed runs; not discounted at this level.
runners.comment: Below par on turf on last two runs but better judged on his winter AW form; not ruled out

runners.name: Baileys Ontherocks
runners.spotlight: 0-11 and going the wrong way; returning to 5f and AW may help and interest is heightened by the booking of Billy Loughnane.
runners.comment: 0-11 and going the wrong way; Billy Loughnane booked and returning to 5f/AW both helpful

runners.name: Wondrous
runners.spotlight: Offered a bit more when fourth of six in a similar race at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) 11 days ago; drop in trip/new headgear both possible avenues of improvement; check betting.
runners.comment: Latest effort slightly more encouraging; drops in trip with blinkers fitted; may do better

runners.name: Chiedozie
runners.spotlight: Exposed maiden who was well beaten in his four runs this year (after a 410-day layoff); the latest was 6.30 Wolverhampton on Monday when he made an awkward start and was soon tailed off.
runners.comment: Exposed maiden who was well beaten in his four runs this year; latest was 6.30 Monday

runners.name: Fuseboard
runners.spotlight: Achieved little in terms of RPR but he has only had one run out of novice/maiden company and he fared a lot better than the distance beaten suggests when fourth of eight at Lingfield (7f, AW; first run after wind and gelding operations) eight weeks ago; drops in trip and grade and open to improvement; the betting should provide a clearer picture.
runners.comment: Down in trip/grade and open to improvement; the betting should be revealing

runners.name: Rohini
runners.spotlight: Poor form in three runs for Robert Cowell and fared no better when eighth of nine in a similar event at Leicester on stable debut four weeks ago; bred to sprint but not easily recommended; stable also runs Bishop's Glory.
runners.comment: No improvement for switch to 0-50 company on stable debut last month; bred to do better

runners.name: Dontwaryboutathing
runners.spotlight: Little in the way of solid form but she did show some speed over an extended 7f in a 0-50 at Lingfield (good to firm) ten days ago; drops to 5f for the first time and in a weak race; not discounted.
runners.comment: Little solid form but has low mileage and dropping to 5f may help; not discounted

races.race_name: Get Raceday Ready Handicap

runners.name: River Wharfe
runners.spotlight: Conditions to suit and he is on a winning mark but it has been a long time since he won above Class 6 company; others are stronger.
runners.comment: Conditions to suit but it has been a long time since he won above Class 5 company

runners.name: The Hare Rail
runners.spotlight: 0-18 and his record is a patchy one; below par at Salisbury last month and the change of headgear isn't enough to tempt.
runners.comment: 0-18 and has a patchy record; well beaten latest and another headgear change today
runners.owner: Mrs Muriel Forward & Dr G C Forward

runners.name: Reds And Wolves
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who ran creditably on his handicap debut last month (7f, AW; first run for 384 days); stepping up in trip could unlock further progress and Oisin Murphy takes over for the first time.
runners.comment: Unexposed 4yo; promising return from a year off last month; new trip can help; contender

runners.name: Eagle Day
runners.spotlight: C&D win in March (second past the post) came off this mark and was the last occasion Rossa Ryan rode him (record for the jockey an impressive 113121); another big run on the cards.
