runners.comment: Conditions to suit and he has a fine record for Rossa Ryan (113121); solid candidate

runners.name: Bajan Bandit
runners.spotlight: Has won over 1m but better at shorter and this extended trip might prove beyond him; not beaten far over 7.4f on Saturday; Billy Loughnane booked but others appeal more for win purposes.
runners.comment: Not beaten far on turf on Saturday but this extended 1m looks further than ideal

runners.name: Auburn Avenue
runners.spotlight: 16-race maiden; well beaten at Ffos Las on last month's stable debut but her peak Irish efforts bring her into the reckoning; the betting should guide.
runners.comment: Chance on her Irish best but 0-16 and her stable debut last month was a low-key run

runners.name: American State
runners.spotlight: Returned from a wind operation in December with a C&D success in February; scored over 1m at Southwell in April too when just 2lb lower; not so good on his next three starts but this is an ease in grade and he can't be discounted.
runners.comment: Two AW wins this year, including C&D; revival could be forthcoming now dropped in grade

runners.name: R P McMurphy
runners.spotlight: Both wins this winter came over C&D but in Class 6 company; a career best will be required to take this back from a 144-day break.
runners.comment: Two C&D wins this winter but at a lower level; career best needed back from a break

runners.name: Kit Gabriel
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; on last winning mark; two good runs on Polytrack this spring but his form dipped at Kempton six weeks ago; chance with a revival.
runners.comment: C&D winner and on a winning mark; flopped last time but the type to bounce back

runners.name: Symphony's Song
runners.spotlight: Unexposed filly who offered a bit more when fourth on turf debut at Nottingham (extended 1m, good) in May; faces a more realistic assignment now handicapping.
runners.comment: Offered a bit more at Nottingham in May and now faces her first realistic assignment

runners.name: Pursuit Of Truth
runners.spotlight: Course winner (9.5f) last summer in his only run in a tongue tie; not beaten far into fourth at Kempton (1m) when last seen in February; sold out of Pat Phelan's yard for 1,000gns in March; new trainer brings the tongue tie back; not discounted.
runners.comment: Course winner (9.5f) last summer; return of a tongue tie looks a positive on stable debut

runners.name: Cephalus
runners.spotlight: 11-time AW winner; quiet for Chelsea Banham this year but dropping down the weights and he is one of four runners on the card for connections that all require close market surveillance.
runners.comment: 11-time AW winner; on a dangerous mark and close market surveillance is advised

races.race_name: Cavani Sartorial Classified Stakes (Div I)

runners.name: First Encounter
runners.spotlight: Won twice at this level earlier in the year, including C&D; finished behind Gloriola when fifth over C&D three weeks ago; should give a good account.
runners.comment: Two wins this year, including C&D; finished behind Gloriola here last month

runners.name: Masqool
runners.spotlight: Prolific winner down the years; not at very best this summer but he drops into a classified race with apprentice Myla Coppins taking off a useful 7lb; may need more of a test these days.
runners.comment: Prolific down the years; drops into a classified event but may need more of a test now

runners.name: Blue Jammin
runners.spotlight: Won a small-field nursery at Chepstow (1m, soft) last September; three heavy defeats this year see him drop to 0-50 company; cheekpieces now tried.
runners.comment: 1m nursery win last year; three heavy defeats this time around; now tries cheekpieces

runners.name: Ignition
runners.spotlight: 19-race maiden who is usually seen over further; struggled on turf last time but he'll be happier back on AW; tongue tied for the first time but not a solid option.
runners.comment: 0-19 and usually seen over further; new tongue tie today; not a solid option

runners.name: Gloriola
runners.spotlight: Back to form when chasing home a rival miles ahead of his mark over C&D three weeks ago; still has low mileage; considered.
runners.comment: Second to a flourishing rival over C&D three weeks ago; still low mileage; solid claims

runners.name: Stacey Racey
runners.spotlight: On a losing run but she was in form at a low level earlier in the year, including when third over C&D 119 days ago; cheekpieces now given a go; chance.
runners.comment: Placed over C&D when last seen in March; now tried in cheekpieces; contender

runners.name: Nautical Sky
runners.spotlight: Has shown some ability at a low level, including C&D, and now drops into her first 0-50 classified event; needs serious consideration.
runners.comment: Some promise at a modest level; tackles first 0-50 classified; one to take seriously

runners.name: Jean's Boy
runners.spotlight: £60,000 yearling; three heavy defeats in novice races at up to 7f; new trip/headgear need to spark a transformation but it is not out of the question.
runners.comment: Poor novice form at up to 7f; bred to do much better; now tried in headgear

runners.name: Rogue Soldier
runners.spotlight: He's beaten just one rival in seven runs for current yard; drops into 0-50 company with blinkers added; hardly persuasive.
runners.comment: Offered nothing in seven runs for current yard; now tries blinkers

races.race_name: Cavani Sartorial Classified Stakes (Div II)

runners.name: Knightmare
runners.spotlight: Still seeking his first win after 20 attempts but he has finished second in three of his last four starts, including C&D; Billy Loughnane booked and he is more appealing than most.
runners.comment: Exposed 20-race maiden but he arrives in top form and has more appealing claims than most

runners.name: Nutcracker
runners.spotlight: 0-12 but he hit the frame twice in similar races over C&D in March; better form when beaten a neck into second at Chepstow (1m, soft) last month; set to go well once again.
runners.comment: 0-12 but he is steadily progressive and looks set to be in the thick of it once again

runners.name: Three Builders
runners.spotlight: Little in the way of solid form and he has finished well down the field in two handicap runs this year (1m/1m2f); the switch to AW and classified company needs to spark a transformation.
runners.comment: Little solid form and he has suffered two heavy defeats in handicaps this year; AW debut

runners.name: King's Courtier
runners.spotlight: Appeared to run a better race when fourth in a 9.5f maiden here in April; tailed off in two minor handicaps on turf since; the return to Wolverhampton isn't enough to tempt.
runners.comment: Ran his best race at this track but his overall profile is far from convincing

runners.name: Celebrating Ethel
runners.spotlight: Won a similar race over 9.5f here in March but she hasn't been at that level since, fading right out of it in a C&D handicap yesterday; vulnerable to anything progressive.
runners.comment: Won a similar race over 9.5f here in March; less good since, including here yesterday

runners.name: Kessaar Power
runners.spotlight: AW wins have come at Chelmsford and this track hasn't seen him to best effect; should be competitive at this level but he ran poorly at Lingfield last month when soft ground shouldn't have been an issue.
runners.comment: Poor run at Lingfield last month when soft ground shouldn't have been an issue

runners.name: Churchill's Spirit
runners.spotlight: No immediate improvement for the switch to classified events when fourth of seven, beaten over 13l, at Yarmouth (1m2f, soft) last month; tongue tie worn there is now dispensed with and blinkers are given a go; does at least have the potential to do a bit better.
runners.comment: Modest form so far but low mileage and the new blinkers could give her a lift
runners.owner: Hambleton Racing Lvi & Mrs G Jarvis

runners.name: Wingstar
runners.spotlight: Minor promise on AW for Sam England; poor form for new yard though and the return to AW/fitting of accessories isn't enough to tempt.
runners.comment: Poor form for current stable; return to AW/fitting of accessories not enough to tempt

runners.name: Caitlin G
runners.spotlight: Peak RPR of 35 from her six runs to date (5f-1m); plenty to prove starting out for a new stable.
runners.comment: Peak RPR of 35 from her six runs (5f-1m); plenty to prove on her stable debut

races.race_name: Follow @attheraces On X Handicap (Div I)

runners.name: Mintana
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; landed a 0-50 classified event at Lingfield in February and she ran her best race since when third over 7f here five weeks ago; more appealing than many in a weak race.
runners.comment: C&D winner; scored over 7f in February and ran well over that trip here last time; chance

runners.name: Maury
runners.spotlight: Usually seen over further; won a 7f handicap at Lingfield (AW) in March and turned in another fair effort here in May; heavy defeats on turf twice since but returning to this surface is in his favour.
runners.comment: Arrives after two heavy turf defeats but he should be much happier back on AW

runners.name: The Fixer
runners.spotlight: Two fine runs over 5f at Southwell in November/December; back to form when landing a small-field 5f handicap here nine days ago but he's struggled badly otherwise this year; last into the stalls here (6.30) on Monday but started rearing and never figured; clear risks.
runners.comment: 5f win here nine days ago; struggled badly otherwise this year, latest here on Monday

runners.name: Lifeguard
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise for Andrew Balding last year but he has beaten just one rival home in three starts for new connections (including after a wind op before the latest); drops back to 6f with a point to prove.
runners.comment: Interesting on last year's form but not shone over further for new yard; risky back at 6f

runners.name: Unique Procedure
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in three 6f runs this summer; faces a more suitable assignment on her handicap debut and could have a bit more to offer.
runners.comment: Down the field in her three runs this year; has a more realistic chance now handicapping

runners.name: No News
runners.spotlight: On a long losing run; ended 2025 with a low-key effort and it was a similar story on his seasonal return in May; has the ability to feature but too much guesswork involved; blinkers back today.
runners.comment: On a losing run; should be sharper for his reappearance but others appeal more

runners.name: Power Cut
runners.spotlight: Low-level form in his four starts but he is an unexposed 3yo from a shrewd yard and this is a weak race; the betting should be revealing.
runners.comment: Unexposed 3yo; handicap debut sixth not without hope for the future; betting to guide

runners.name: Tomarlo
runners.spotlight: Two creditable 5f efforts for this yard, including here, and he continues to edge down the weights; likely to be in the thick of it back at 6f.
runners.comment: On a dangerous mark and he has run two sound races (5f) for this yard; in the mix again

runners.name: Conquest Of Power
runners.spotlight: His C&D third in March was his only effort of note since wind surgery last summer; it hasn't been a springboard to better things and he's not a solid option.
runners.comment: His third over C&D in March a rare bright spot in the last 12 months; others are safer

runners.name: Fancy Dancer
runners.spotlight: Won three minor sprint handicaps for Ollie Sangster last year; poor form in three runs in 2026, the latest at Bath last week, and she arrives with a point to prove.
runners.comment: Three wins for O Sangster in 2025 but she's struggled so far in 2026, including last week

runners.name: Crown Dreams
runners.spotlight: Started his career with two good runs over 7f on slow turf; no impact in three handicaps in the 2023-24 AW campaign; drops to 5f for his first run for 901 days.
runners.comment: Absent 901 days; tackles a new trip; plenty to prove

races.race_name: Follow @attheraces On X Handicap (Div II)

runners.name: On Key
runners.spotlight: 0-22 but he has been banging at the door in recent months, most recently a close second over C&D nine days ago; cheekpieces were absent there but they return tonight; should go well again.
runners.comment: 0-22 but he has been threatening of late, just missing out over C&D last week; contender

runners.name: Dr Ali
runners.spotlight: Won a classified event over C&D in March; not so good since but he has slipped in the weights and will be a danger to all if anywhere near his best.
runners.comment: C&D win in March; less good since but he has slipped to a dangerous mark

runners.name: Miss Magic Dragon
runners.spotlight: Won at Bath (5.7f, good) in May on just her second handicap run; solid fourth at Redcar next time and she wasn't well drawn when sixth at Lingfield; latest Bath run harder to forgive but this is weak and cheekpieces could give her a lift.
runners.comment: Her good run of form ground to a halt last time; new cheekpieces could revive her fortunes

runners.name: Molly Mac
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden but she has run well in both starts this year (7f, soft and 5f, good to firm), the latest her first run for Micky Fenton; 6f should suit and she could still have a bit more to offer; shortlisted.
runners.comment: 11-race maiden but she has run well in both starts this year; 6f should suit; shortlisted

runners.name: Jake Loves Laura
runners.spotlight: Placed a few times, including over C&D, but absent since failing to stay 7f in February; likely vulnerable once more.
runners.comment: Has run well over C&D but she is an exposed maiden who has been absent for 129 days

runners.name: Dreamcrafter
runners.spotlight: He's gone backwards since his fair debut effort; shorter in the betting than may have been anticipated ahead of his reappearance last month but still finished well beaten.
runners.comment: He's gone backwards since his fair debut effort; needs a full revival

runners.name: Hellcat
runners.spotlight: Yet to make much of an impact in handicaps but her best effort for Ross Burdon came over C&D; drops into a 0-55 but with improvement required.
runners.comment: Best handicap run came over C&D but others have more pressing claims

runners.name: Amaysmont
runners.spotlight: No win since November 2024; ran a fair race when second of six at Carlisle four weeks ago and Rossa Ryan booked tonight; holds place claims but others are stronger for win purposes.
runners.comment: On a losing run but ran okay last time and Rossa Ryan is booked; place claims

runners.name: Red Walls
runners.spotlight: 18 months since his last win but he is fully effective over C&D and he ran well for third here when last seen in January; this might not be the time to catch him.
runners.comment: Conditions to suit but on a losing run and absent since January; others look stronger

runners.name: Walking On Clouds
runners.spotlight: Nine-time winner, the latest a comfortable success in a 6f handicap at Lingfield (AW) last month; his subsequent defeat on soft turf is easy to forgive; high on the list.
runners.comment: Easy AW win before struggling on soft turf last time; high on the list

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 512 Handicap

runners.name: The Craftymaster
runners.spotlight: Record of ten wins from 34 starts on the AW; goes particularly well here, gaining fourth course success when scoring by 14l over 2m nine days ago; this trip no problem; will be hard to beat with a 5lb penalty.
runners.comment: 10-34 on AW, four of his wins here, latest nine days ago when scoring by 14l; big chance
runners.owner: R Miles, V Miles, T Stamp & Partner

runners.name: Havachoc
runners.spotlight: Consistent; won three on the bounce on AW over 1m4f in January/February; fair second at Beverley on Friday; stays 1m6f; each-way chance.
runners.comment: Hat-trick of AW wins earlier this year (1m4f); fair run on turf on Friday; each-way chance

runners.name: V Power
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been over C&D, the latest in April when tongue-tie was on for first time; not been in quite such good form since.
runners.comment: Both wins have been over C&D, the latest in April; not been at his best on last two runs

runners.name: Mick The Hat
runners.spotlight: Best run when third at Ffos Las on handicap debut last month (1m4f, good to soft); tailed off here next time (well beaten previous AW run); bit to prove.
runners.comment: Best run when third at Ffos Las on handicap debut; poor form both AW starts; bit to prove

runners.name: Last Flight
runners.spotlight: Unexposed; fair 6.5l fifth over 1m4f here on handicap debut last time; needs to improve for this step up in trip.
runners.comment: Unexposed; fair fifth over 1m4f here on h'cap debut; needs to improve for step up to 1m6f

runners.name: Kingston Sunflower
runners.spotlight: Decent hurdler (2l last of four in handicap at Market Rasen last month); fair run when 3l seventh of 12 over C&D on latest AW start (September 2025); place chance.
runners.comment: Winning hurdler; fair run over C&D on latest AW start (September 2025); place chance

races.race_name: Bet Now With fairplaybet.co.uk Classified Stakes

runners.name: Valsharah
runners.spotlight: 26-race maiden but did remarkably well to snatch second behind Big Time Rascal over C&D (good to firm) last Tuesday, when breaking awkwardly and pulling hard; clearly not the most straightforward and another change of headgear is tried but should go close if he gets the breaks.
runners.comment: 26-race maiden but did well to snatch second behind Big Time Rascal over C&D last Tuesday.

runners.name: Big Time Rascal
runners.spotlight: Finds winning races difficult (2-25) but both wins have been over C&D, the latest in a similar contest (good to firm) last Tuesday; carries a 5lb penalty but looks sure to run his race.
runners.comment: Landed similar contest over C&D last Tuesday.

runners.name: Manhattan Chute
runners.spotlight: Sprung a 50-1 surprise in a 0-60 handicap at Lingfield (5f, AW) in January, but subsequent efforts suggest it may have been a flash in the pan; hard to recommend despite the drop in class.
runners.comment: Sprung a 50-1 surprise in a 0-60 handicap at Lingfield in January; poor form since.
runners.owner: J May, R L Field, W Trenchard, J Pook

runners.name: Some Nightmare
runners.spotlight: Has been running consistently at a modest level and runs in his first classified for a while, which may be just what the doctor ordered; this front-runner should not be far away.
runners.comment: Has been running well at a modest level and runs in his first classified for a while.
runners.owner: Mrs S M Maine & Roger Gould & Partner

runners.name: Port Hedland
runners.spotlight: Doubled his tally when landing similar contest at Bath (5.5f, good) last month but couldn't replicate that form when eighth of 11 in race won by Big Time Rascal  (C&D, good to firm) last Tuesday.
runners.comment: Won at Bath last month but only eighth here last Tuesday.

runners.name: Bated Breeze
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden (5f-7f) who's been tried in two forms of headgear; runs in his first classified, he usually over-races and can miss the kick, so will never come without risk.
runners.comment: Regressive maiden (5f-7f) who's been tried in two forms of headgear.

runners.name: Mishy's Star
runners.spotlight: Placed in a 7f classified event at Southwell in February but she has followed that with three heavy defeats; swaps cheekpieces for first-time blinkers but hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Placed at Southwell in February but she has followed that with three heavy defeats.

runners.name: Barnsnape Boy
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent sort but landed his second course win (7f) in a similar race last month, with Donagh Murphy on board; the drop back in trip may not suit.
runners.comment: Inconsistent sort but landed his second course win (7f) in a similar race last month.

runners.name: Molly Marine
runners.spotlight: Yet to make the frame in six starts; has left Jack Jones since his latest run in April; steps into her first classified on stable debut and needs to show improvement.
runners.comment: Yet to make the frame in six starts.

runners.name: Apple's Angel
runners.spotlight: Showed her first form for this yard when fourth of 11 (beaten 3l) behind Big Time Rascal over C&D last Tuesday; there should be little between the pair on revised terms but there is a doubt that she will repeat the dose.
runners.comment: First form for this yard when fourth behind Big Time Rascal over C&D last Tuesday.
runners.owner: P And Mrs L Rowe And John Turner

runners.name: Coast
runners.spotlight: Hasn't won for nearly two years and showing no signs of a renaissance.
runners.comment: Hasn't won for nearly two years and showing no signs of a renaissance.

runners.name: Coiled
runners.spotlight: Modest sprint maiden as 2yo but 2025 did not go at all well; absent for a year; changed hands and left Andrew Martin but last of 11 on stable debut at Windsor eight days ago.
runners.comment: Last of 11 on stable debut at Windsor eight days ago.

runners.name: Poet
runners.spotlight: Has finished stone last on his last nine starts; impossible to recommend.
runners.comment: Has finished stone last on his last nine starts; impossible to recommend.

runners.name: Better Nature
runners.spotlight: Showed fair form in a couple of maidens and holds place claims but may be better off when he tries his hands in nurseries.
runners.comment: Showed fair form in a couple of maidens and holds place claims.

runners.name: Radahn
runners.spotlight: Made promising debut when second of ten in a similar contest at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) three weeks ago; the step up in trip should suit on this first turf start and he should go close.
runners.comment: Made promising debut when second in a similar contest at Wolverhampton three weeks ago.

runners.name: Parading
runners.spotlight: Making steady improvement as he steps up in distance; runner-up in a seller at Leicester (7f, good to firm) in May; should not be far away.
runners.comment: Runner-up in a seller at Leicester in May; should not be far away.

runners.name: Telegraphic
runners.spotlight: Made a solid start when fourth of 11 on debut at Carlisle (7f, good to firm) 13 days ago; needs to improve but that is not out of the question.
runners.comment: Made a solid start when fourth on debut at Carlisle 13 days ago.

runners.name: Alice Rocks
runners.spotlight: Has shown little in two runs so far and may need more time.
runners.comment: Has shown little in two runs so far and may need more time.
runners.owner: Mps Racing And Jjg Racing Partnership

runners.name: Serenity Bay
runners.spotlight: 16-1 and very green when beating one in maiden at Windsor (6f, good) on her debut in May; this Bayside Boy filly needs to take a step forward.
runners.comment: 16-1 and very green when beating one in maiden at Windsor on her debut in May.

runners.name: Romanovich
runners.spotlight: Scored off this mark at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) in March and in good form since until a below-par effort when beaten 9l at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) in May; the type to bounce back and he should be competitive.
runners.comment: In good form until a below-par effort when beaten 9l at Chepstow in May.
runners.owner: Mrs S M Maine & Roger Gould

runners.name: Prefer The Sister
runners.spotlight: Has been running well since joining this yard and recorded her first turf win over C&D (good to firm) last Tuesday with Dion Baker (has won since) two places back; shoulders a 5lb penalty but may have more to give.
runners.comment: Recorded her first turf win over C&D last Tuesday with Dion Baker two places back.

runners.name: Dion Baker
runners.spotlight: Is in cracking form at present, winning four of his last five starts, two of which have been over C&D; saddled with a 4lb penalty for his win at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) last Thursday, this trailblazer will take some catching.
runners.comment: Is in cracking form at present, winning four of his last five starts.

runners.name: My Dad Tom
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden; not progressing, albeit he suffered an overreach last time.
runners.comment: 11-race maiden; not progressing, albeit he suffered an overreach last time.

runners.name: Kondratiev Wave
runners.spotlight: Continues to run with credit and recorded his eighth career win at Lingfield in February; has made the frame on all four starts since and shouldn't be far away.
runners.comment: Continues to run with credit and recorded his eighth career win at Lingfield in February.

runners.name: Rainbow Sorbet
runners.spotlight: No improvement for the switch to handicaps when fourth of nine at Brighton (5.3f, good to firm) in May in first-time visor (retained); not easily recommended.
runners.comment: No improvement for the switch to handicaps when fourth at Brighton in May.

runners.name: Dalmally
runners.spotlight: Sole success came here in 1m maiden in 2024 when trained by Hughie Morrison; has been below his best for current yard this year and although his mark continues to fall he doesn't look a betting proposition at present.
runners.comment: Has been below his best for current yard this year.

runners.name: Mighty Ruler
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 20 starts came off this mark at Lingfield (7f, AW) in January; turf form not so hot; fell at Lingfield last time; others more persuasive.
runners.comment: Sole win from 20 starts came off this mark at Lingfield (7f, AW) in January.

runners.name: My Boy Jack
runners.spotlight: Fair third in a classified over C&D (good to firm) last month but has yet to win on turf with all three wins coming at Wolverhampton; best to leave until he returns to his favoured track.
runners.comment: Fair third in a classified over C&D last month but has yet to win on turf.

races.race_name: Fairplay Lets Bet On It! Handicap

runners.name: Annexation
runners.spotlight: Has yet to score this year but is getting close, finishing second of eight over C&D (good to firm) last Tuesday; 8lb lower than for his two wins last autumn.
runners.comment: Second over C&D last Tuesday; should go close.

runners.name: Gone Rogue
runners.spotlight: Can race freely and has done a lot of his racing over shorter, often in headgear, but proved this trip is within range on his Windsor comeback in May; below that level twice since though.
runners.comment: Proved this trip is within range on his Windsor comeback in May; below that level since.

runners.name: Pershalla
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark over 1m4f at Kempton AW in April but below par in handicaps at Windsor and back at Kempton since; drops back in trip and needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Got off the mark over 1m4f at Kempton AW in April but below par in handicaps since.

runners.name: Voix De Bocelli
runners.spotlight: Both wins came in 2025 over C&D; not in the best of form at present and needs to show improvement.
runners.comment: Not in the best of form at present and needs to show improvement.

runners.name: Super Hit
runners.spotlight: Got back on track for first success with this yard at Epsom (1m2f, good) last Wednesday; runs off the same mark here as that was a race confined to apprentices and he should be in the shake-up once more.
runners.comment: Got back on track for first success with this yard at Epsom last Wednesday.

runners.name: Boubyan
runners.spotlight: Has an inconsistent profile but both wins have been off higher marks so cannot be discounted.
runners.comment: Has an inconsistent profile but both wins have been off higher so cannot be discounted.

runners.name: Bownder
runners.spotlight: Yet to score this year but has run well a few times, latest when third of five at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) ten days ago; should be thereabouts but would prefer some give in the ground.
runners.comment: Yet to score this year but has run well a few times, finishing close up ten days ago

runners.name: Myna
runners.spotlight: Has won twice this year and did well after a slow start to claim fourth in a similar race at Lingfield (1m2f, good) last month; if he breaks on terms then he holds strong claims.
runners.comment: Did well after a slow start to claim fourth in a similar race at Lingfield last month.

runners.name: Graffiti
runners.spotlight: It's been a while since he got his head in front on the line; was beaten less than 3l at Windsor last month and drops into a classified; needs to be considered.
runners.comment: Beaten less than 3l at Windsor last month and drops into a classified.

runners.name: Launceston
runners.spotlight: 0-14 under rules and has been out of sorts over hurdles and on the Flat this year for Joe Ponting; makes his debut for shrewd yard but hard to make a case for.
runners.comment: 0-14 under rules and has been out of sorts over hurdles and on the Flat this year.

runners.name: Bear Steps
runners.spotlight: 3yo who's not finished closer than 8l to a winner and has finished last in her last two contests with cheekpieces worn (removed here); sports first-time tongue-tie and steps up in trip but has plenty to prove.
runners.comment: 3yo who's not finished closer than 8l to a winner; sports first-time tongue-tie

runners.name: Dogged
runners.spotlight: Hasn't won since 2023 but went close when beaten a neck over C&D (good to firm) last month; first run in a classified and should go close.
runners.comment: Hasn't won since 2023 but went close when beaten a neck over C&D last month.

runners.name: Mist Of Time
runners.spotlight: Had shown little until finishing fourth in a similar event at Yarmouth (1m2f, good to firm) 11 days ago; needs to build on that but may do so and has place claims at least.
runners.comment: Had shown little until finishing fourth in a similar event at Yarmouth 11 days ago.

runners.name: Outrace
runners.spotlight: Has three wins but has only beaten four rivals in his last five starts; has been gelded since his last outing in January; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Has three wins but has only beaten four rivals in his last five starts.

runners.name: All About George
runners.spotlight: Yet to make the frame in six starts; first go in a classified but others are more compelling.
runners.comment: Yet to make the frame in six starts; first go in a classified but others more compelling.

runners.name: Rory Rocket
runners.spotlight: Scored on the AW in March and recorded his first win on turf over C&D (good) four weeks ago; tends to be slowly away but finishes strongly; holds strong claims to go in again off 4lb higher.
runners.comment: Scored on the AW in March and recorded his first win on turf over C&D four weeks ago.

runners.name: Kento
runners.spotlight: Has three AW wins at Wolverhampton and got off the mark on turf over C&D in May off 7lb lower; placed twice since and should go close.
runners.comment: Got off the mark on turf over C&D in May off 7lb lower.

runners.name: Honour Your Dreams
runners.spotlight: Has six wins to his name but yet to score for his current trainer; best recent effort when runner-up at Lingfield (5f, AW) last month; not out of this.
runners.comment: Best recent effort when runner-up at Lingfield last month.

runners.name: Too Darn Good
runners.spotlight: 0-9 but ran his best race this year when third of eight at Goodwood (5f, good) last month in first-time cheekpieces (retained); just needs a bit more to shed his maiden tag.
runners.comment: 0-9 but ran his best race this year when third at Goodwood last month.
runners.owner: K Hunter, D Leon And Hunscote Stud Ltd

runners.name: Faustus
runners.spotlight: Trailblazer who is not the force he once was, but was runner-up at Windsor (5f, good to firm) last month; should give his supporters a run for their money but vulnerable to a late closer.
runners.comment: Trailblazer who is not the force he once was, but was runner-up at Windsor last month.
